What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer:
I expected the dorm to have something in kitchen. But I had to buy all kitchen gear (pots, pans, plates etc.).
Also the room had nothing but a bed and a closet. I had to buy quilts, pillows, curtains, and so on.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Beers in the bars (contra in the supermarket). Transport (bus). Housing.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your traineeship destination (city/region)? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available at your traineeship destination (organization/city/region)? *
questions.answer: Fitness centers, skiing park with lifts, bars, clubs, swimming pool (Tromsøbadet), saunas, cross country skis, hiking, and a bunch of other stuff.

questions.question: Which non-academic activities would you recommend to future trainees visiting the same destination (organization/city/region)? Why? *
questions.answer: Skiing in the alpin-park, sauna at the harbor (Pust), hiking all the mountains (especially Tromsøtinden).

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting trainees see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Skiing in the alpin-park (winter time), sauna at the harbor (Pust), hiking all the mountains (especially Tromsøtinden).

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your trainee host? *
questions.answer: Easy. The difference between universities in Denmark and Norway is small.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of the destination (city/country)? *
questions.answer: Very easy. The difference between Denmark and Norway is small.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with locals? *
questions.answer: Meet them at bars, or get friends at the university.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: There was a lot of possibilities for outdoor activities.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going on a traineeship to the same city/region? *
questions.answer:
It is very complicated to get the exchange in order, so start in VERY good time.
Save up some money to do things in your spare time.
Remember to bring very warm clothes.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future traineeship students? *
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: The hikes, and the academic stuff I learned at UiT.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the traineeship? *
questions.answer: My master thesis.

questions.question: Is there anything UCPH could have done different (before/during/after) in regard to the traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: Better coordination between UiT and University of Copenhagen. Make the exchange process simpler.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
